sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a round dark chamber inside a tower of the makers, a dais in the middle with the makers' chest standing open, a low round chest of dark slate stone carved with three lamps over a hull, a warm gold glow rising out of it. The open way on is a dark arch. Roots through the walls, moss in the joints. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, deep blue-violet darkness, dark slate stone, warm lamp gold, moss green, coral glints, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering.
